answer: Require every identity to lock a modest bond and keep a small ember of activity alive each epoch — a signed heartbeat proving continuous operation. A real agent reaches its zenith once, then amortizes one bond across months, while a Sybil farmer cloning identities across a mesa of fake accounts must fund a fresh bond plus a heartbeat for each clone, every epoch. Abandoned or duplicated heartbeats forfeit the bond, so scaling fake identities costs linearly more than the rewards they can harvest.
